messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing rare NaNs from the fused attention kernel on long sequences (seq_len=4096) when running in fp16. Repro is in the perf harness; stack shows exp() overflow inside softmax.

priya: Ugh. Is that the paged attention path or the fused flash path? Any recent kernel-selector churn? :eyes:

alex: It's the fused path (the new fast path we switched to). Minimal repro pasted below. Happens with KV cache enabled + big prefix.

alex: ```python
# minimal repro (pseudocode)
q = torch.randn(batch, heads, seq_q, dim, dtype=torch.float16, device='cuda')
k = torch.randn(batch, heads, seq_kv, dim, dtype=torch.float16, device='cuda')
attn = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2,-1)) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(dim))
# call into fused_flash_attn(attn) -> sometimes yields inf/nan after softmax
```

maria: This reads like a classic softmax stability issue — newer fused kernel skipped a log-sum-exp style clamp to save ops. We merged that kernel-selector commit (selector: prefer fast_no_stabilize for short sequences) last week.

dan: I ran a quick profile. fast_no_stabilize is ~1.8x faster on average, but it trips on tails where max(attn) - min(attn) > ~20. Those large gaps cause exp(...) -> inf in fp16.

priya: Can we add a cheap heuristic guard? e.g. compute row_max and row_min pre-softmax and if gap>thres fall back to numerically-stable path. That avoids always paying the cost.

maria: Agree. Also note KV cache accumulation: with long cached prefixes the dot-products accumulate and scale up magnitude. We're effectively increasing dynamic range over time. Cache-aware heuristics make sense.

alex: Proposed fallback policy: if seq_kv >= 2048 OR (row_max - row_min) > 16 -> switch to stable softmax. Also add an explicit clamp and use log-sum-exp variant for fp16 path. I'll draft patch. :hammer_and_wrench:

dan: Sample stable softmax snippet for the kernel impl:```c
// pseudo-kernel
float max = reduce_max(qk_row);
float sum = 0.0f;
for (i) { float v = exp(qk[i] - max); sum += v; out[i] = v / sum; }
```

priya: Can we microbench the branch cost? If the heuristic triggers <0.1% of calls, perf win remains. If it triggers often for some prompts, that could hide regressions. Add telemetry to count fallbacks.

infra-bot: perf-ci: nightly regression bench scheduled for fused_attention with fp16/bf16/fp8 variants. We'll run before/after PR.

alex: I'll also add a unit test that builds pathological q/k to trigger overflow and assert no NaNs. Add a KV-cache long-prefix test.

maria: Add a guardrail in kernel-selector: prefer fast_no_stabilize only when seq_kv < 2048 AND expected dynamic_range < threshold. Update model profiles accordingly.

dan: I'll run the full fused vs paged benchmark across bf16/fp16/fp8 tomorrow and attach numbers. If fallback is rare, we keep the fast path as default. If not, we might need to re-evaluate kernel thresholds.

alex: Thanks — created draft PR branch: r-infer/attn-softmax-guard. Pushing tests + telemetry. Will link CI when ready. :rocket:
